Shopify Development

Custom storefronts built around your products and the way your customers shop.

The work

A store should be easy to use and easy to manage. I build Shopify storefronts with reusable sections, clear product information and a considered mobile experience.

How we approach it

We start with your catalogue, brand and customer journey. Then I turn the agreed design into a theme with editable sections, sensible defaults and focused functionality.

Typical scope

  • Theme development
  • Custom sections
  • Product templates
  • Mobile navigation
  • Launch checks

Scope and timing are agreed for each project.
